label: PF Backlog 216
title: Backend: provider/vendor API-key registry + cloud allowlist + per-provider cost caps
body:
## Problem / why Paid/free-tier API models need credentials, an allow/deny list (which vendors a project may call), and hard cost caps so a media run cannot overspend. Keys are currently ad-hoc env reads. ## Goal & value A single registry that every adapter/router consults for auth, enablement, and spend limits. ## In scope - `config/provider-keys.json` (schema) + resolver: key source = env var/secret ref per provider (direct vendors AND aggregators: fal.ai, Replicate, kie.ai, Together, OpenRouter). - **Cloud allowlist/denylist** per project (`products/

/capabilities.json`) — a compliance switch. - **Per-provider + per-run cost caps** feeding `budget_allocator` (BI-0194); hard stop on breach. - Adapter/router integration: registry presence = provider usable; missing key = graceful fallback to a self-host or free-tier model, else clear failure. - Never log key material (secret hygiene); audit that no key is committed. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - A provider without a configured key is skipped by the router (falls back, no crash). - A run that would exceed the cap is blocked with a clear reason and a partial-cost report. - Denylisted provider is never called even if keyed. ## Verification / test plan - Unit: key resolution precedence, allowlist enforcement, cap arithmetic (fake providers). - Audit: grep shows no secret values in the repo; wired_audit stays green.

dashboard_impact.reason: Has a dashboard surface (see paired item).

_note: DONE: core/credentials.py (single owner) + config/provider-keys.json (env-var REFERENCES only, never secrets; kind direct|aggregator; required_for kinds) + budget caps (per_run_cap_usd/per_provider_cap_usd). Loader is ROOT-anchored (product-forge/.env then .env.local), never overrides process env, never logs values. API: key_for/has/provider_kind/required_for/missing_for/check_budget/status; CLI python -m core.credentials --status|--missing. Wired into core/orchestrator/llm_client._get_api_key (with inline fallback). .env.example + docs/credentials.md. Tests: 6 (env resolution, metadata, missing_for, budget caps, redaction). VERIFIED: suite 478 passed; compileall 0; wired_audit 0 (provider-keys.json registered). Readiness: opencode-go/opencode-zen/openrouter/gemini keyed.
